description:
A tidy desktop, and files you can find.

Give every project a place. PecoFence organizes the icons on your Windows 11 and 10 desktop into fences: translucent glass panels you can take in at a glance.

LESS TIME SORTING
Set rules for file types, names, age or size. New desktop files appear in the right fence automatically. Automatic sorting leaves their locations on disk unchanged.

FIND IT AS YOU TYPE
Press Ctrl + Alt + Space to open Peek, and your fences come above the current app. Then just type: matching files and folders show up under the search box. Chinese names can be found by pinyin or initials too. Enter opens the selected item, Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+9 open the first nine, and Esc takes you back to work. Everything is a free file search tool. Turn on Everything search in Settings, and the whole computer is searched as well. You can also choose Press Ctrl twice as the shortcut: a quick double press of Ctrl then opens Peek with the search box ready.

THE RIGHT FOLDER IN OPEN AND SAVE DIALOGS
In an Open or Save As dialog you often have to click through folder after folder. With Jump in file dialogs on, switch to File Explorer and back, and the dialog jumps to the folder Explorer shows. Ctrl+G jumps there too, and a click on a folder fence takes the dialog to that fence's folder. Jump in file dialogs is off by default. The first time it could help, PecoFence offers to turn it on, and Settings shows how it works. The Peek search helps any file dialog, even with the switch off: press Enter on a result, and an Open dialog opens that file, while a Save dialog goes to its folder and fills in the name.

LET YOUR AI SET IT UP
PecoFence includes pecofence-cli. Tell a coding agent such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor what you want in your own words: it reads your current setup and applies the changes, from new fences and sorting rules to icon sizes, colors and themes. Snapshots and configuration export keep a copy of a setup you like.

SMALL TOOLS WHEN YOU WANT THEM
There are three: notes with to-dos, a clock with the date, and script fences. A script fence shows what your own script prints, such as the weather. Its rows can be clicked to open a link or tick a to-do. Click Add on the Tools page of Settings to put one on your desktop. New note and New tool are also in the tray menu and in each fence's menu. Script fences come with three ready examples: Weather, GitHub repository activity and PC status. You can also use your own script. Turning off the Tools switch hides all tools and stops every script.

A SPACE FOR EVERY PROJECT
Combine related fences into tabs. Switch in a click, or drag a tab out into its own fence. Add a folder fence that shows any folder on your PC, and browse its subfolders in place.

MAKE ROOM FOR FOCUS
Double-click empty desktop space to hide your fences and again to bring them back. Roll a fence up to its title bar and hover to expand it.

GLASS THAT FITS YOUR DESKTOP
Choose Fluent or Liquid Glass, light or dark, then adjust each fence's color and opacity. Save your layout with snapshots and backups.

LIGHT ON YOUR PC
PecoFence is a native application that uses about 2 to 5 MB of memory at rest, as shown in Task Manager. The settings window loads only when you open it.

Free and open source under Apache 2.0. No app account required. Eleven built-in display languages, available offline. Designed for Windows 10 22H2 / Windows 11 x64.

PecoFence uses real files: file operations you initiate, including moves, renames and deletions, affect files on disk. Your normal Windows desktop icons return when the app exits.

releaseNotes:
What's new in this update:
• Place freely: icons outside your fences stay where you drop them, as on the Windows desktop. To turn it on, right-click one of them and choose Place freely.
• Smart fences show the live result of a search, such as Downloads of the last 7 days. Make one with New smart fence… in the tray menu.
• Ctrl+F filters a folder fence or smart fence as you type.
• Each virtual desktop can have its own fences: right-click a fence and use Show on virtual desktop.
• The Peek search has type tabs such as Documents and Images, and each result has a right-click menu.
• Files dropped on a program in a fence open with that program.
• Fit to content fits a fence's height to its icons, and Ctrl+Z undoes moving or deleting a fence.
• Fences no longer freeze while File Explorer is busy, and scrolling is smoother on slower PCs.
Fixes:
• Right after signing in or switching virtual desktops, a double-click on the desktop hides the fences again.
• Shortcuts to folders follow the sorting rules for shortcuts.
• Fences no longer overlap after the display scale changes.
• Your layout is no longer replaced with the default fences when an antivirus program holds the configuration at startup.
